description.zh: 目录名称。长度为2~255个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（\_）或者短划线（-）。
description.en: The directory name. The name must be 2 to 255 characters in length. The name must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 企业AD对应DNS的IP地址。目前仅支持设置一个。请确保该IP地址在所选的交换机网络下可以访问。
description.en: The IP address of the DNS server corresponding to the enterprise AD. You can specify only one IP address. Make sure that the specified IP address is accessible in the network of the selected vSwitch.

description.zh: 输入企业AD的全限定域名（FQDN），同时带有主机名和域名。相同的域名只能注册一次。
description.en: The fully qualified domain name (FQDN) of the enterprise AD system. The value must contain the hostname and the domain name. You can register each FQDN only once.

description.zh: 域管理员的用户密码。最长支持64个英文字符。
description.en: The password of the domain administrator. The password can be up to 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 域管理员的用户名。最长支持64个英文字符。
description.en: The username of the domain administrator. The username can be up to 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 是否为使用云电脑的用户赋予本地管理员权限。
description.en:
Specifies whether to grant the local administrator permissions to users that are authorized to use cloud computers in the office network.

Valid values:

*   <!-- -->

    true

    <!-- -->

    (default)

    <!-- -->

*   <!-- -->

    false

    <!-- -->

    <!-- -->

description.zh:
是否启用MFA认证。开启后，该目录下的所有AD用户登录云电脑时，输入正确密码后，还需输入虚拟MFA设备生成的动态验证码。

> 首次登录时，需绑定MFA设备。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). After you enable MFA, all AD users in the directory must enter a dynamic verification code generated by the virtual MFA device in addition to a correct password when they log on to a cloud computer.

>  When end users log on to a cloud computer for the first time, they must bind an MFA device.

Valid values:

*   true

    <!-- -->

    <!-- -->

*   <!-- -->

    false (default)

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

The type of the AD connector.

Valid values:
- 1 (General)
- 2 (Advanced)

description.zh:
企业已有AD子域的DNS地址。    
如果设置了`SubDomainName`，而未设置此参数，则认为子域DNS和父域一致。
description.en:
The DNS address of the existing AD subdomain.\
If you specify the `SubDomainName` parameter but you do not specify this parameter, the DNS address of the subdomain is the same as the DNS address of the parent domain.

description.zh: 企业已有AD子域的全限定域名（FQDN），同时带有主机名和域名。
description.en: The FQDN of the enterprise AD subdomain. The value must contain the hostname and the subdomain name.

description.zh: 交换机ID。目前仅支持设置一个。
description.en: Details of the vSwitch IDs. You can specify only one vSwitch ID.

descriptions.zh: AD目录用于对接企业自有AD（Active Directory），适合较大规模的云电脑部署。对接企业AD需要支付目录费用，详细信息请参见[计费概述](~~188395~~)。
descriptions.en: An AD directory is used to connect to an enterprise's existing Active Directory and is suitable for large-scale cloud computer deployment. You are charged directory fees when you connect your AD to cloud computers. For more information, see [Billing overview](~~188395~~).
